items.information: This Fewest Moves competition is part of the **WCA African Championship for 2026**, but is being hosted 3 weeks before the main Championship in several separate countries and venues across the continent. Please see the **Locations** tab for more information. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU0MTA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6e29e3f5ea7fe3728a156b02818d2878a1ffc9ce/2026_African_Champs_Logo.png) Please note that only the **3x3x3 Fewest Moves** will be held - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or fewer (excluding rotations) in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event. Please see [this section](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#article-E-fewest-moves) of the WCA Regulations for more information on Fewest Moves solving. There will be a short break inbetween attempts for grading, as well as snack/tea breaks for competitors. For the website for the main WCA African Championship taking place in Cape Town, South Africa, please visit the [official WCA website](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCAAfricanChampionship2026) and the [official CubingZA website](https://cubingza.org/wca-african-championship-2026/). **GUESTS** Please note that guests and spectators are **not encouraged** at this competition, unless special arrangements have been made prior to the event with the competition organisers (for example, for younger competitors that require a parent or guardian present). The venues are small and there must be absolute silence for the duration of each attempt. **VENUES** Please see the **Locations** tab for more info! If you are a Junior or Full Delegate and would like to host a location in Africa for this competition, please reach out to the organizers! Venues can be added up until 15 August 2026 (three weeks before the competition).

items.information: **Español** Esta es la primera competencia organizada en esta sede y también será la primera competencia oficial del año en Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 será una competencia oficial de la World Cube Association (WCA), inspirada en la cultura maya y en la figura de Kukulcán, uno de los símbolos más representativos de Mesoamérica. Nuestro objetivo es ofrecer una experiencia competitiva de alta calidad, promoviendo la comunidad del speedcubing en el occidente de Guatemala y mostrando parte de nuestra identidad y cultura a todos los participantes. Esta competencia se llevará a cabo en dos locaciones diferentes. Para consultar la ubicación correspondiente a cada día, revisa la pestaña “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout”, donde se indica la ubicación de la competencia para el viernes 11, así como para los días sábado 12 y domingo 13. ¡Sean todos bienvenidos a Quetzaltenango y esperamos que disfruten de Kukulcán Open 2026! **English** This is the first competition organized at this venue and also the first official WCA competition of the year in Quetzaltenango. Kukulcán Open 2026 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) competition inspired by the Mayan culture and Kukulcán, one of the most iconic symbols of Mesoamerica. Our goal is to provide a high-quality competition while helping grow the speedcubing community in western Guatemala and sharing part of our culture and identity with every participant. This competition will take place at two different venues. Please refer to the “Distribución de áreas / Venue Layout” tab to find the competition location for Friday the 11th, as well as for Saturday the 12th and Sunday the 13th. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAzNzU0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c8c5e71fb067c6e8e5103b433be893d948fe1be6/CaminosGuanajuato.jpg) **ESPAÑOL** 🎵***"No tengo trono ni reina, ni nadie que me comprenda, pero sigo siendo el rey..."***🎶 ## Caminos de Guanajuato – Guanajuato, Guanajuato 2026 La ruta **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** finaliza su recorrido y en **Guanajuato, Guanajuato**, un lugar que refleja el carácter y la riqueza cultural de nuestro estado, donde la historia, la tradición y la vida cotidiana se entrelazan en cada rincón. Esta competencia forma parte de una travesía que celebra no solo el speedcubing, sino también la identidad cultural de nuestro estado, conectando distintas sedes bajo un mismo espíritu competitivo y festivo. En cada parada, la música de *José Alfredo Jiménez* acompaña simbólicamente el camino. Sus canciones, que han dado voz al sentir guanajuatense, inspiran esta edición dedicada a Guanajuato. El **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** estará encantado de recibirte con los brazos abiertos para compartir la pasión por el cubo y, al mismo tiempo, invitarte a conocer más sobre la historia del estado, sus municipios y el legado cultural que ha trascendido fronteras. Queremos que tu experiencia vaya más allá de la competencia: que sea también un encuentro con nuestras raíces, nuestras historias y nuestra música. Te esperamos en Guanajuato para culminar juntos los **"Caminos de Guanajuato"**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la **Asociación Mundial de Cubos**. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ **ENGLISH** 🎵***"No tengo trono ni reina, ni nadie que me comprenda, pero sigo siendo el rey..."***🎶 The **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** route ends its journey in **Guanajuato, Guanajuato**, a city that reflects the character and cultural richness of our state, where history, tradition, and everyday life come together in every corner. This competition is part of a journey that celebrates not only speedcubing, but also the cultural identity of our state, connecting different host cities through a shared spirit of competition and celebration. At each stop along the way, the music of *José Alfredo Jiménez* symbolically accompanies the journey. His songs, which have become an essential expression of the spirit and emotions of the people of Guanajuato, inspire this edition dedicated to Guanajuato. The **Guanajuato Rubik’s Team** will be delighted to welcome you with open arms to share the passion for the cube and, at the same time, invite you to learn more about the history of the state, its municipalities, and the cultural legacy that has transcended borders. We want your experience to go beyond the competition: we want it to also be an encounter with our roots, our stories, and our music. We look forward to seeing you in Guanajuato to finalize the **"Caminos de Guanajuato"** together. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the **World Cube Association**. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) prior to competition. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Para acessar o local do evento será necessário informar o CPF e nome tanto do competidor quanto de seus acompanhantes. Estes dados deverão ser incluídos na caixa de comentários, durante a inscrição. Inscrições sem estas informações não serão aceitas **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** To access the competition's venue it will be required to inform an ID number for both the competitor and their guests. This information must be included in the comment section of your registration. Registers without this data will not be accepted **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1NDUwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--56cfd892944339a15388ab39d58ba62744ee8d31/image.png) Ο διαγωνισμός **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** σηματοδοτεί την έναρξη της αγωνιστικής σεζόν 2026–2027 για το ελληνικό speedcubing. Cubers από όλη την Ελλάδα θα συναντηθούν για ένα διήμερο γεμάτο γρήγορες λύσεις, προσωπικά ρεκόρ και δυνατές αναμετρήσεις, ανοίγοντας με τον καλύτερο τρόπο τη νέα σεζόν των επίσημων WCA διαγωνισμών. Ο διαγωνισμός έχει και ξεχωριστή σημασία, καθώς αποτελεί τον πρώτο αγώνα που θα προσμετρήσει στη νεοσύστατη **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), εγκαινιάζοντας μια νέα εποχή για το ελληνικό αγωνιστικό cubing. Είτε συμμετέχεις για την εμπειρία, είτε κυνηγάς νέες επιδόσεις και πολύτιμους βαθμούς στη League, το **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** είναι το ιδανικό ξεκίνημα της σεζόν. **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το **Α μέρος** σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **MONO σε έναν από τους δύο σε αυτή τη σειρά**. Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 4x4 * pyraminx * skewb * clock Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) The competition **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** marks the beginning of the 2026–2027 competitive season for Greek speedcubing. Cubers from all over Greece will gather for a two-day event filled with fast solves, personal bests, and exciting competition, kicking off the new season of official WCA competitions in the best possible way. This competition is also of special significance, as it will be the first event to count towards the newly established **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), marking the beginning of a new era for competitive cubing in Greece. Whether you are participating for the experience or aiming for new personal bests and valuable League points, New Cubing Season Athens 2026 is the perfect way to start the season. Important: This competition **is Part A** of a two-competition series. Competitors may participate in ONLY one of the two competitions in this series. **Events (Part A):** * 3x3 * 4x4 * pyraminx * skewb * clock Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2026 Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown II 2026

venue.name: [Swiss Games Museum](https://museedujeu.ch/)

items.information: Le Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown fait partie de la [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), qui se compose de plusieurs compétitions réparties sur toute l'année. Tout le monde est le bienvenu, que vous souhaitiez ou non participer à la finale de la Swisscubing Cup. Pour cette compétition, **les points de qualification pour la finale de la Swisscubing Cup 2026 ne peuvent être cumulés que dans les disciplines suivantes : 3BLD, 4BLD, 5BLD, Multi-Blind et FMC.** Toutes les autres disciplines présentes lors de cette compétition ne font pas partie de la Swisscubing Cup. **Note aux débutants :** Cette compétition s'adresse prioritairement aux compétiteurs expérimentés et est organisée en conséquence. Bien que les débutants soient les bienvenus, l'expérience montre que peu d'autres néophytes participent à ce tournoi spécifique. Pour une première expérience en compétition, un tournoi plus "accessible" est souvent un choix plus agréable. __________________________ Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/). Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. **Hinweis für Neulinge:** Diese Competition richtet sich in erster Linie an erfahrene Speedcuber und ist entsprechend organisiert. Zwar sind Neulinge willkommen, an diesem Turnier nehmen erfahrungsgemäss nur wenige andere Einsteiger teil. Für den ersten Competition-Besuch ist ein einsteigerfreundlicheres Turnier oft die angenehmere Wahl. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the [Swisscubing Cup 2026](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2026/), made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2026 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 3BLD, 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup. **Note for newcomers:** This competition is primarily aimed at experienced speedcubers. While newcomers are welcome, there will be only a small number of other beginners attending this event. For a first competition, a more beginner-friendly event is often the more enjoyable choice.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk1Njc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--40a4223db9dd06f7297c00e40277715abf8db574/image.png) Ο διαγωνισμός **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** σηματοδοτεί την έναρξη της αγωνιστικής σεζόν 2026–2027 για το ελληνικό speedcubing. Cubers από όλη την Ελλάδα θα συναντηθούν για ένα διήμερο γεμάτο γρήγορες λύσεις, προσωπικά ρεκόρ και δυνατές αναμετρήσεις, ανοίγοντας με τον καλύτερο τρόπο τη νέα σεζόν των επίσημων WCA διαγωνισμών. Ο διαγωνισμός έχει και ξεχωριστή σημασία, καθώς αποτελεί τον πρώτο αγώνα που θα προσμετρήσει στη νεοσύστατη **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), εγκαινιάζοντας μια νέα εποχή για το ελληνικό αγωνιστικό cubing. Είτε συμμετέχεις για την εμπειρία, είτε κυνηγάς νέες επιδόσεις και πολύτιμους βαθμούς στη League, το **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** είναι το ιδανικό ξεκίνημα της σεζόν. **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το **B μέρος** σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **MONO σε έναν από τους δύο σε αυτή τη σειρά**. Αγωνίσματα B' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2X2 * 5X5 * One-Handed (OH) Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) The competition **New Cubing Season Athens 2026** marks the beginning of the 2026–2027 competitive season for Greek speedcubing. Cubers from all over Greece will gather for a two-day event filled with fast solves, personal bests, and exciting competition, kicking off the new season of official WCA competitions in the best possible way. This competition is also of special significance, as it will be the first event to count towards the newly established **Greek Cubing League** (https://greekcubingleague.gr), marking the beginning of a new era for competitive cubing in Greece. Whether you are participating for the experience or aiming for new personal bests and valuable League points, New Cubing Season Athens 2026 is the perfect way to start the season. Important: This competition **is Part B** of a two-competition series. Competitors may participate in ONLY one of the two competitions in this series. **Events (Part B):** * 3x3 * 2X2 * 5X5 * One-Handed (OH) Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

Tips: - Arrive at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the event you will be participating in; - The cube you will be competing with must be in good condition; - By registering, you agree to assist as a judge, runner, or in any other role requested by a delegate; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, so take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates. - By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we always have room for new cubers. Have fun!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTk0NjcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d276ee4a1432869c38d809b8802b47006f609e10/Megamente_2026.png) # Español Hay desafíos que no se vencen solo con velocidad; se dominan con la capacidad de visualizar lo que otros no pueden. **Megaminx** es una prueba de estrategia, creatividad y control bajo presión. Es el eje de esta competencia. Pero **Mega-Mente** es mucho más que un solo rompecabezas. Cada categoría ha sido seleccionada para ponerte a prueba. **¿Tienes lo necesario para adaptarte a cualquier desafío?** Porque no importa qué tan rápido gires un cubo. Lo que importa es... **qué tan lejos puedas llevar tu mente.** #### **¡BIENVENIDOS A MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 es una competencia oficial de la WCA, por lo que **todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/)**. ​ **AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA** En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ # English ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Some challenges can't be conquered by speed alone; they are mastered through the ability to visualize what others cannot. **Megaminx** is a test of strategy, creativity, and composure under pressure. It is the centerpiece of this competition. But **Mega-Mente** is much more than a single puzzle. Every event has been carefully chosen to challenge you. **Do you have what it takes to adapt to every challenge?** Because it doesn't matter how fast you can turn a cube. What matters is... **how far you can push your mind.** #### **WELCOME TO MEGA-MENTE PUEBLA 2026!** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ This competition is made possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Juan Carlos Quiroz**. Mega-Mente Puebla 2026 is an official WCA competition, so **all competitors must be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations)**. **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.information: (HR) Croatian Quiet Championship 2026 je natjecanje koje se održava u Zagrebu. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost. Preporučujemo da budete upoznati s WCA Pravilnikom. Budući da se FMC i discipline slaganja naslijepo ne nalaze na [Croatian Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CroatianChampionship2026), ovo je Vaša prilika da postanete Hrvatski prvak u tim disciplinama. Nagrade za najbolja 3 hrvata će biti dodijeljene na svečanoj ceremoniji u Petrinji tjedan dana kasnije. *Ne morate se natjecati na Croatian Championshipu kako bi ste se natjecali na ovom natjecanju.* Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja. **NAPOMENA - NA OVOM NATJECANJU SE NEĆE ODRŽATI KLASIČNE DISCIPLINE KAO NPR. 3X3X3 KOCKA** (EN) Croatian Quiet Championship 2026 is a competition that will take place in Zagreb. Anyone may participate, regardless of nationality or age. We recommend that all competitors become familiar with the WCA Regulations. Since FMC and blindfolded events will not be held at [Croatian Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CroatianChampionship2026), this is your chance to become the Croatian champion in those events. Awards for the top 3 Croatian competitors will be presented at the ceremony in Petrinja one week later. *You do not have to compete at Croatian Championship to take part in this competition.* For more information, please check the other tabs on the competition page. **NOTE: THIS COMPETITION WILL NOT INCLUDE REGULAR EVENTS SUCH AS THE 3X3X3 CUBE.**

items.name: Trondheim Høst 2026
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Høst 2026! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026#78798-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Høst 2026! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2026#78798-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEwMTIwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--82167337bca974bb92ecb210a31ed309c9633397/photo_2026-08-03_11-44-49.jpg)Змагання зі швидкісного складання кубика Рубіка на підтримку України 🇺🇦 Запрошуємо всіх охочих взяти участь у змаганнях зі швидкісного складання кубика Рубіка — події, яка об'єднає любителів спідкубінгу заради доброї справи. Це не лише можливість перевірити свої навички, позмагатися з найсильнішими учасниками та провести час у дружній атмосфері, а й підтримати Україну. Разом ми доводимо, що кожен рух має значення, а єдність робить нас сильнішими. Уся актуальна інформація щодо реєстрації, розкладу, правил, можливих змін та інших організаційних питань публікуватиметься в Telegram-групі заходу. Складай швидко. Підтримуй Україну. Разом до перемоги! 💙💛 Speed ​​​​Rubik's Cube Competition in Support of Ukraine 🇺🇦 We invite everyone who wants to take part in the speed Rubik's Cube competition - an event that will unite speedcubing enthusiasts for a good cause. This is not only an opportunity to test your skills, compete with the strongest participants and spend time in a friendly atmosphere, but also to support Ukraine. Together we prove that every move matters, and unity makes us stronger. All relevant information regarding registration, schedule, rules, possible changes and other organizational issues will be published in the Telegram group of the event. Solve it quickly. Support Ukraine. Together to victory! 💙💛

items.name: Bergen Open 2026
items.information: ### 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Bergen Open. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ##### Nye Deltakere Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2026#77513-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors). ##### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette er også helt gratis. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. --- ### 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to to Bergen Open! This competition is open to everyone who wants to compete. #### New Competitors There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenOpen2026#77513-nye-konkurrenter-new-competitors) tab. ##### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for free aswell. We still strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/bergenopen2026/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

items.information: ##### 🇧🇷 Seja bem vindo ao **Cascavel ao Cubo 2026**! Instruções de participação: * Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CascavelaoCubo2026/register). * As inscrições vão até o dia **02/10/2026**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes. * Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará. * Todos os participantes devem ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. * O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição. * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. * Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. * Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande suas dúvidas para para o e-mail da organização (cascavelaocubo@gmail.com), e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores! * Divirta-se! --- ##### 🇺🇸 Welcome to **Cascavel ao Cubo 2026**! Participation instructions: * All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CascavelaoCubo2026/register) tab. * Registration closes on **10/02/2026**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register for the 3x3x3 Cube event, in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies. * Be present at the competition venue, in possession of your cube, at least 30 minutes earlier for any event you are participating. * All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. * The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition. * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. * All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in. * If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the organization (cascavelaocubo@gmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers! * Have fun!

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! Esta competição funcionará da seguinte maneira: Os competidores poderão fazer quantas modalidades queiram, contanto que se atentem ao limite cumulativo de **30 minutos** para todas as suas tentativas. Cada competidor será alocado em um grupo (1, 2 ou 3), no qual irá competir. Nos demais grupos, o competidor deverá, obrigatoriamente, atuar como juiz, embaralhador ou corredor, sob a condição de ter seus resultados desqualificados caso se recuse. Apenas o primeiro colocado de cada modalidade será premiado. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors! This competition will work as follows: Competitors may attempt as many events as they wish, as long as they adhere to the cumulative time limit of **30 minutes** for all their attempts. Each competitor will be assigned to a group (1, 2, or 3) in which they will compete. In the other groups, the competitor must serve as a judge, scrambler, or runner; refusal to do so may result in disqualification of their results. Only the first-place finisher in each event will receive a prize.

You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le mardi 6 octobre 2026 à 20h (11 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Ottawa Side Events Series This competition is in a series with [Ottawa Side Events B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaSideEventsB2026). You will only be able to compete in one of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le mardi 6 octobre 2026 à 20h (12 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Série de Ottawa Side Events Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec [Ottawa Side Events B 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OttawaSideEventsB2026). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces deux compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire aux deux compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://youtu.be/LH3QG7krdgc?si=zHT9ze8Wlfopxkr2). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc?si=L4lK3I42zL1eMo9j). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjExMDYzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2b39acc8afc2f42f3a6da807026b51e138f0abec/image.png) **SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026** Το ετήσιο ραντεβού μας στη Θεσσαλονίκη επιστρέφει! Στις 24 και 25 Οκτωβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά για έναν μεγάλο διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές. Το Salonica Autumn Open 2026 θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα τον δεύτερο διαγωνισμό της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! Τα μέλη της GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) θα έχουν **επιστροφή 7€** στην κάρτα τους, αμέσως μόλις οριστικοποιηθεί η εγγραφή τους κατά την ολοκλήρωση των εγγράφων. Ετοιμαστείτε για ακόμη ένα αξέχαστο cubing Σαββατοκύριακο! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) **SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026** Our annual meetup in Thessaloniki is back! On October 24 and 25, 2026, all Cubers gather once again for a major two-day competition packed with speed, friendly rivalry, and great moments. Salonica Autumn Open 2026 will also serve as the second competition of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! Members of the GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) will receive **a €7 refund** back to their card as soon as their registration is finalized upon completing the registration process. Get ready for another unforgettable cubing weekend! Grab your cubes, gear up, read the rules, and join the cubing celebration! Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered complete, you must complete the registration process on the competition's WCA page AND pay the participation fee using your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Para acessar o local do evento **será necessário informar o CPF e nome** tanto do competidor quanto de seus acompanhantes. Estes dados deverão ser incluídos na caixa de comentários, durante a inscrição. Inscrições sem estas informações não serão aceitas **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** To access the competition's venue it **will be required to inform an ID number** for both the competitor and their guests. This information must be included in the comment section of your registration. Registers without this data will not be accepted **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

Teilnehmende aller Erfahrungsstufen sind herzlich eingeladen – ganz gleich, ob es eure erste Competition ist oder ihr bereits an vielen Wettbewerben teilgenommen habt. Wir freuen uns auf ein Wochenende mit offiziellen Solves, neuen persönlichen Bestzeiten und dem Austausch mit der Community. Bitte lest vor der Anmeldung alle Informationen auf der Wettbewerbsseite sorgfältig durch. Wir hoffen, euch in Wuppertal zu sehen! **English** Dear cubers, We are excited to invite you to the 2nd Wuppertal Cubing Weekend 2026 on October 24–25, 2026. Following two successful editions in autumn 2025 and spring 2026, we are once again delighted to welcome you to Wuppertal for an official WCA competition weekend. Participants of all experience levels are warmly invited to join—whether this is your very first competition or you have already attended many events. We look forward to a weekend of official solves, new personal bests, and connecting with the cubing community. Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering. We hope to see you in Wuppertal!

items.information: ![Speedcubing Austria Logo](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg3OTA4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--279a016a5545862ad7b5d27844f6185ca48fc68a/SpeedcubingAustria_Logo_comp_page.png) ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr die ersten Austrian Nationals ankündigen zu dürfen! Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Lukas Schwarz, Marcel Niedl, Noah Kirrane, Phillip Leimer, Simon Praschl und Thomas Strasser und delegiert von Fabian Staber, Florian Truckenthanner, Jeremia E. Neuhold, Pranjal Khan und Viktor Kalmar. Die Championship wird im Großen Saal und Turnsaal der Pfarre Akkonplatz stattfinden. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! **English:** We are happy to announce the first ever Austrian Nationals! The speedcubing competition is organised by Felizian Baumgartner, Julian Ostadal, Lukas Schwarz, Marcel Niedl, Noah Kirrane, Phillip Leimer, Simon Praschl and Thomas Strasser and delegated by Fabian Staber, Florian Truckenthanner, Jeremia E. Neuhold, Pranjal Khan and Viktor Kalmar. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

venue.name: Univali - Univerdade do Vale do Itajaí

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEyNDgzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e88ce5718f2045f0e748da68cc0c5f3f442c3f38/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-09-02%20at%2015.56.14.jpeg) Bem-vindos ao CAU ao Cubo 2026, em Itajaí! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8). Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino, novatos, seniores e alunos do CAU na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação extra-oficial será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida apenas pela primeira rodada). A premiação extra-oficial dos alunos do CAU será feita de acordo com uma pontuação geral entre todas as modalidades, e será dividida entre Ensino Fundamental I, Ensino Fundamental II e Ensino Médio. Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para os eventos do segundo dia (3x3x3, 2x2x2, Pyraminx e 3x3x3 OH). Por gentileza, esteja no local com no mínimo 1 hora de antecedência. 🇺🇸 Welcome to the CAU ao Cubo 2026, competition in Itajaí! Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any difficulties with registration, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/4yo7IqbcgOA?si=SJNiCFCSh-eLN550). Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We will have awards for all official events, as well as unofficial awards for women, beginners, seniors, and CAU students in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (they will not be based solely on the first round results). The unofficial awards for CAU students will be based on an overall score across all events and will be divided into Elementary School I, Elementary School II, and High School. On-site registration will be accepted only for the events on the second day (3x3x3, 2x2x2, Pyraminx, and 3x3x3 One-Handed). Please arrive at the venue at least 1 hour in advance.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg) The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** have gracouisly offered us the venue at a very reduced rate as part of their support for the competition. Please continue to return the favour to them by supporting their restaurant and accomodation. Also follow the hotel on socials by scanning the QR code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg) ##Accommodation The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. items.information: # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. # 멀티 블라인드: 전체 참가자 중 선착순 50%만 가능 # [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80103-spectator-limit)이 존재합니다. WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80100-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80099-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. # MBLD: First 50% of registrants only. # There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80103-spectator-limit). If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80100-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80099-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE4NjQxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ab88a0502a3ba472356141b81e552f91ce257a19/image.png) ### Deutsch Herzlich willkommen zu Cottbus Cubing 2026! Wir freuen uns sehr, euch alle zur zweiten offiziellen Speedcubing-Competition in der Lausitz begrüßen zu dürfen! Am Wochenende vom 06. bis 08. November wollen wir an den Erfolg des Vorjahres anknüpfen und Euch alle wieder herzlichst nach Cottbus einladen. Dieses Jahr möchten wir uns sogar noch steigern und gehen mit mehr Teilnehmenden und mehr Comp-Tagen an den Start. Dieses Jahr wird Cottbus Cubing von GANCube unterstützt Wir wünschen allen Teilnehmenden spannende Wettkämpfe, faire Duelle und vor allem viel Freude am Würfeln! **Bitte lies dir alle Tabs sorgfältig durch, damit du mit dem Ablaufplan und allen Modalitäten vertraut bist.** ### English Welcome to the Cottbuser Cubing Competition! We are delighted to welcome you all to the second official Speedcubing Competition in the Lausitz! From November 6th to 8th, we aim to build on last year's success and happily want to invite you all to Cottbus once again. This year, we want to surpass even that, with more participants and more competition days. This year, Cottbus Cubing is being supported by GANCube We wish all participants exciting solves, fair competition, and – above all – lots of fun with the cubes! **Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering.** Vielen Dank! Habt alle ein entspanntes Wochenende

items.information: Välkomna till Götalandsmästerskapet 2026! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Götaland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Götalandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2026#77782-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)". ----- Welcome to Götalandsmästerskapet 2026! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Götaland can win titles and prizes at the Götaland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2026#77782-regionala-masterskap-2026-regional-championships-2026)". items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEyMDUzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fb89206b5263dbd95b0c2c4f82523a97b1aff0d5/home%20wca%20ic%2026.png) # Selamat Datang di Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026! Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 merupakan kejuaraan nasional speedcubing yang akan diadakan di Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. Kompetisi ini akan diadakan selama tiga hari dan terbuka untuk umum. Setiap peserta diharapkan untuk memerhatikan time limit dan cut-off untuk setiap event karena diatur lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya. Setiap peserta wajib hadir 15 menit sebelum event yang diikuti dimulai. Jika peserta terlambat, maka panitia berhak mendiskualifikasi peserta tersebut. **Pendaftaran on the spot TIDAK AKAN DITERIMA.** **Catatan Penting:** Terdapat batasan limit peserta untuk Event berikut: * 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (terbatas untuk 24 pendaftar pertama) * 4x4x4 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama) * 5x5x5 Blindfolded (terbatas untuk 10 pendaftar pertama) * 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (terbatas untuk 20 pendaftar pertama) Akan ada **3 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini: * **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori * **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan * **Kategori Anak (Indonesia)** - Top 3 pemenang kompetisi untuk peserta berkewarganegaraan Indonesia berusia di bawah 13 tahun (per 01 November 2026) untuk event 3x3x3 Dengan mendaftar, peserta dan pendamping setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi atau kerusakan/kehilangan barang selama acara berlangsung. Peserta akan mendapatkan Lanyard dan Name Tag. Pastikan memantau jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka jadwal dapat berubah tergantung jumlah pendaftar tiap event. Silakan melakukan registrasi di laman [daftar](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) dan konfirmasi di form ini: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7. Jika Anda tidak dapat mengakses form tersebut, silakan mengirimkan bukti pembayaran registrasi ke email ini: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). Dalam email tersebut, mohon tuliskan nama lengkap, WCA ID (jika Anda memilikinya), tanggal lahir, daftar event yang diikuti, dan bukti pembayaran. ----------------------- # Welcome to Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026! Rapid Academy Indonesian Championship 2026 is the national speedcubing championship that will be held at Lippo Icon Gajah Mada, Jakarta. The competition will take place over three days and is open to the public. All competitors are expected to pay close attention to the time limit and cut-off for each event, as they are set more strictly than in a typical competition. All competitors must arrive 15 minutes before the event starts. If the competitor is late, the competitor will be disqualified. **On the Spot registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.** **Important Notes:** There are competitor limits for the following events: * 3x3x3 Fewest Moves (limited to the first 24 registered competitors) * 4x4x4 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors) * 5x5x5 Blindfolded (limited to the first 10 registered competitors) * 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (limited to the first 20 registered competitors) There will be **3 categories of winners** in this competition: * **Indonesian Category** - The top 3 Indonesian competitors in each event * **Open Category** - The top 3 competitors overall, regardless of nationality * **Kids Category (Indonesia)** - Top 3 winners of the competition among Indonesian citizens under 13 years of age (as of 01 November 2026) in the 3x3x3 event By registering, competitors and their guests acknowledge that the organizers, the NSA, and the WCA are not responsible for any personal injury or any loss of or damage to personal belongings during the event. All competitors will receive a Lanyard and a Name Tag. Please check the competition schedule regularly during the registration period, as it may change depending on the number of registrations for each event. Please register on the [register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IndonesianChampionship2026/register) page and confirm your registration by completing this form: https://forms.gle/Yq4km6UVR2qt2Jnw7. If you cannot access the form, please submit your proof of payment for the registration to this email: [nlarchie1@gmail.com](mailto:nlarchie1@gmail.com). In the email, please write your full name, WCA ID (if you have it), date of birth, list of events, and the proof of payment.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjE5MTU3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6767acf00e820f8d8610aadf63d58431dcd8b4b9/cubestore%20pre-championship.jpg) **PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026** Στις 14 και 15 Νοεμβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά στο **Panellinios Club House** για έναν ξεχωριστό διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές. Το **PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026** θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα την 3η αγωνιστική της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! Τα μέλη της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE** ([https://greekcubingleague.gr](https://greekcubingleague.gr)) θα έχουν **επιστροφή 4€** στην κάρτα τους, αμέσως μόλις οριστικοποιηθεί η εγγραφή τους μετά την ημερομηνία που αυτές θα κλείσουν. Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός, που θα διαρκέσει και τις δυο μέρες του Σαββατοκύριακου, αποτελεί το ιδανικό αγωνιστικό warm-up πριν από το μεγάλο γεγονός της χρονιάς, το **Εθνικό μας Πρωτάθλημα**. Είναι η ευκαιρία να δοκιμάσετε τις δυνάμεις σας, να βελτιώσετε τις επιδόσεις σας και να προετοιμαστείτε κατάλληλα για τη μεγάλη διοργάνωση που ακολουθεί. Ετοιμαστείτε για ακόμη ένα αξέχαστο cubing Σαββατοκύριακο! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε να ζήσουμε μαζί μια ακόμη μεγάλη γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. **Σημείωση:** Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή, πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **ΚΑΙ** να γίνει η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026** On November 14 and 15, 2026, all Cubers will meet again at **Panellinios Club House** for a special two-day competition filled with speed, competition and unforgettable moments. The **PRE-CHAMPIONSHIP ATHENS 2026** will also be the third competition of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! Members of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE** ([https://greekcubingleague.gr](https://greekcubingleague.gr)) will receive a **€4 refund** on their card as soon as their registration is finalized, upon completion of the registration process. Taking place over both days of the weekend, this competition will be the ideal competitive warm-up before the biggest event of the year: **our National Championship**. It is the perfect opportunity to test your skills, improve your performances and prepare properly for the major competition that follows. Get ready for another unforgettable cubing weekend! Bring your cubes, read the regulations and join us for another great celebration of cubing! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA1NzMzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--15740010cf766262637c38629cab00fad9ef50e2/1000228331.png) ###### Español Coralito Bahia de Banderas esta de vuelta! Coralito Bahía de Banderas regresa para celebrar su **segunda edición**, retomando el lugar donde comenzó todo. Hace dos años, este evento marcó un momento especial al convertirse en la **primera competencia de la WCA realizada en Bahía de Banderas**, reuniendo por primera vez a speedcubers y aficionados en una misma sede. Esta segunda edición busca volver a reunir a la comunidad del cubing para compartir la emoción de competir, mejorar tiempos, conocer nuevos competidores y, sobre todo, disfrutar de la pasión por los cubos Rubik. Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad **Vallarta Speed**. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ##### AVISO DE FILMACIÓN Y FOTOGRAFÍA En este evento se tomarán fotografías y videos que podrán ser usados por la [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) con fines de promoción, documentación y difusión de nuestras actividades. Al asistir, autorizas el uso de tu imagen en los términos de nuestro Aviso de Privacidad. 📄 Consúltalo aquí 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/ ###### English Coralito Bahía de Banderas is back! Coralito Bahía de Banderas returns for its **second edition**, going back to the place where it all began. Two years ago, this event marked a special moment by becoming the **first WCA competition ever held in Bahía de Banderas**, bringing speedcubers and enthusiasts together at the same venue for the first time. This second edition aims to bring the cubing community together once again to share the excitement of competing, improving times, meeting new competitors, and, above all, enjoying the passion for Rubik’s Cubes. This competition is organized by the **Vallarta Speed community**. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. ##### NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Asociación Mexicana de Speedcubing](https://amscubing.org/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities. By attending, you authorize the use of your image under the terms of our Privacy Notice. 📄 Check it here 👉 www.amscubing.org/privacidad/

items.name: Örebro Open 2026
items.information: Välkomna till den andra upplagan av Örebro Open! Detta blir Sveriges andra tävling med Dual Rounds, vilket innebär att alla tävlande i 3x3, OH och 2x2 har möjligheten att få tävla i minst två rundor. Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to the 2nd edition of Örebro Open! This will be Sweden's second competition with Dual Rounds, which means that all competitors in 3x3, OH and 2x2 are allowed to compete in at least two rounds. Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: (BR) Bem-vindos ao terceiro Unidavi ao Cubo (2026) Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos de inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_ Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação das modalidades extra-oficiais será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada) ATENÇÃO: Inscrições no local serão válidas apenas para o evento 3x3x3 e Pyraminx. Pedimos também atenção ao fato de que quando cada pessoa for entrar na universidade será necessário fazer um cadastro rápido na portaria. A universidade pede esse cadastro como medida de segurança. (EN) Welcome to the third Unidavi ao Cubo (2026) Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problems with how to register, take a look at this video. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_ Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial events awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.) ATTENTION: On-site registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 and the Pyraminx events. Also we want to point out that before each person gets in the university they will need to make a quick registration at the entrance. The university demands this registration for safety standards.

items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara! Decidimos continuar o formato do ano passado, com um dia apenas para modalidades silenciosas, e o segundo dia para as modalidades mais populares. Então pedimos para prestar bastante atenção às modalidades em que você está se inscrevendo. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição" (e na hora da inscrição). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** We are really excited to announce a new Capivara! We have decided to keep last year's format, with one day exclusively to silent events, and the second day for the most popular events. Therefore, we ask you to pay a lot of attention to the events you are registering to. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements" (and during the registration). If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4yo7IqbcgOA). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2026!** 🟥🟨🟩 Este campeonato celebra los 10 años desde que Bolivia organizó su primer Campeonato Nacional, un evento que dio inicio al crecimiento del speedcubing en nuestro país. Desde entonces, nuestra comunidad no ha dejado de crecer, reuniendo a personas de todas las edades y de diferentes regiones, unidas por la pasión por el Speedcubing, el desafío de superar sus propios tiempos y el de compañerismo que caracteriza a la comunidad del speedcubing. Hoy queremos celebrar todo ese camino recorrido con una edición muy especial. La inscripción está abierta para todos, sin importar la edad ni el lugar de donde vengan. ¡Anímate a ser parte de esta celebración y vive un campeonato que quedará en la historia del speedcubing en Bolivia! 🟥🟨🟩 **¡Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2026!** 🟥🟨🟩 His championship celebrates 10 years since Bolivia hosted its very first National Championship, the event that helped kick off the growth of speedcubing in our country. Since then, our community has kept growing, bringing together people of all ages and from all over the country who share a passion for the Speedcubing, chasing new personal bests, and the amazing sense of community that makes speedcubing so special. We're excited to celebrate this journey with a very special edition of the championship. Registration is open to everyone, no matter your age or where you're from. Come join us, meet fellow cubers, and be part of a championship that will make speedcubing history in Bolivia! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA2MDQ0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c0d143d39819bad425907a01d1201cca236592fa/BN26%20-%20WCA%20-%20%20Banner.png)
